question: Which Library page? Same 4 entries in each (2 agreed, 1 draft, 1 broken), under the agreed header. A is today's card grid. B makes the cards denser and shows where each came from. C puts the list and one entry's details side by side, so there is no separate detail page. Click entries in C.

variants.label: Today (control)
variants.changes: Copy of today's LibraryView: a page heading, then up to 3 cards per row with title and status badge, description and example count. The broken entry is a red card with its errors.

variants.label: Dense card grid
variants.changes: Up to 4 smaller cards per row. Status and example count as two same-size pills on top, then title, a 2-line description and the source rounds in a footer. Small page title with the entry count. Tests more entries per screen.

variants.label: List and detail
variants.changes: A 288px entry list on the left (title, status pill, example count). The right pane shows the selected entry: description, examples, provenance and rules. Tests one page instead of list plus detail.
